summary: Verdict PASS: no finding of severity high or medium remains. T1 (Medium) and the lows T2, T3, T5, T6 of pass 1 are closed by my own runs in a fresh clone of the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-5b2 (5cb280c, the tag and HEAD of the project are the same sha): each of my 8 mutants F47, F51, F52, D26, I23, B10, J06, J07 is red in the expected test, and the code is green (`cd app && npm run check` exit 0: unit 119/119, int 47/47, skipped 0, todo 0; `npm run test:e2e` twice, 15 of 15 both times). T4 (the counts of the design's section 10) is still open and is ORCH's, as in pass 1 (Low). Two new Lows of my own (T7, T8) are recorded; neither is a criterion of REQ-111 or REQ-112 and neither blocks.

Mutants: 44 new mutants of my own (34 red; 10 green: 4 equal in effect or no-ops, 2 controls that must stay green, 1 the oracle reading the texts module by design, 3 that are findings or notes: T7, T8 and the U09 note) and 12 re-runs of the 8 pass-1 mutants (F51 under LD-5, LD-6, LD-7, LD-8, LD-9). In total 57 runs in clones; the working tree of the project was not used for any run. The numbers are in `mutants`.

T1 closed. waitLive waits (a conditional wait with a 15 s deadline, no sleep) until #live is non-empty and asserts its text equals the filled live_result or live_back of the page's language; readState with the sixth parameter runs it before the lint. F51 (live_result + ' 5 минут') is red under LD-5, LD-6, LD-7, LD-8, LD-9; F47 (live_back + ' гарантия') and F52 (live_back + ' 5 000 ₸') are red under LD-5, with the message 'after Назад: the live line' and the two texts shown. The ways round it that I tried: a forbidden word in the no-match live text (E02 ru, E30 kk only: red in LD-6), in live_result in kk only (E16, LD-6) and in en only (E17, LD-9), in live_back only for question 1 (E28, red in LD-5), in live_answer for «Не знаю» only (E27, red in LD-5 by the lint of the next state) and for every answer (E08, red); a wrong language (E05, ru text in every language: red in LD-6); the live text a solution's summary (E13: red); a late second write 400 ms after the announcement (E03: red in LD-5, so a line that changes after the read is also found by the later reads); an announcement that is never written (E07: red in 20 s by the 15 s deadline, the test file finishes, no hang); no announcement for the no-match result (E12: red). Racy waits: ANNOUNCE_MS 30 to 250 (E19 LD-5, E20 LD-6) stays green, so the waits do not depend on the 30 ms; the clear of #live is synchronous in the same task that renders the receipt (demo.js announce, openResult), so a stale line cannot be read as the result line; the 15 s deadlines turn a missing line into a red, never a hang. e2e twice in a row green (400.4 s and 399.8 s, exit 0, skipped 0, todo 0).

T2 closed: D26 (the hidden guard inside the frame callback removed) is red in OV-3 (1 of 7: 'the frame that ran while hidden drew none'); D27 (the guard in ask()) is also red there; U07 (the guard only when a frame is owed, so walk frames are drawn hidden) is red in OV-3. U06 (the hidden branch of the frame calls ask(), which has its own guard) is equal in effect and green. U09 (the guard moved before `asked = null`) is green: the state it leaves is reachable only if a frame callback runs while hidden with no visibility event and the page is then shown; OV-3 does not show the page again after the flip (a note, no finding: in a browser the event clears `asked` at once).

T3 closed: I23 (STEP_FRAME_MS 160 to 100) red in OV-2 (1 of 7, 'step 1 at 144 ms: the step frame'); 161 (U04) and 170 (U05) red too; the draw bob removed (U08), the walker's step-frame formula changed (U10) and FRAME_MS 40 to 30 (U11) red in OV-2. T5 closed: B10 red in PP-4 (1 of 7); a second key inside #test-mode (P06), the key of the test line pointing at ai_disclosure (P02), the data-t removed from the AI span (P03), a nested data-t span inside the AI line (P04) and an unknown key (P05) all red in PP-4 only; P07 (an attribute that is not data-t) is a no-op of mine and green. T6 closed: J06 (directories ignored) and J07 (bytes ignored) red in VB-6 (1 of 6); the names dropped (S03), `dir` renamed (S04), not recursive (S06), md5 (S08), two bytes hashed (S09) and a short hash (S10) red in VB-6; S05 (the sort removed) is green, T8.

Own coverage table (from the criteria; pass-1 table stands, this pass adds): REQ-111 criterion 12 (the lint in every state the demo reaches, including the live line): LD-5 A, B, C, D, LD-6, LD-7, LD-8, LD-9 (live_result, live_back and no-match: red, E01-E03, E05, E07, E12, E13, E16, E17, E24, E25, E26, E28, E30); live_answer by the lint of the next state (E08, E27: red); criterion 1 (the pages hold the two lines with their keys): PP-4 (B10, P02-P06: red); criterion 16 and the refusal checks of REQ-111 c9 (the snapshot helper): VB-6, PB-4 (J06, J07, S03, S04, S06, S08-S10: red); REQ-112 criterion 3 and 4 (hidden page, step frame): OV-2, OV-3 (D26, D27, I23, U04, U05, U07, U08, U10, U11: red). No criterion that names a test file lacks it (the 18 files exist, ls).

Counts: unit 119 (118 + VB-6), int 47, e2e 15; skipped 0, todo 0 in all three. Presence guards NPM-5, NPM-7, NM-5, NM-6 match the files and are green in `npm run check` (12 int + 2 pg, 25 unit, 2 e2e files with LD-1..LD-9 and ST-1..ST-6; no file was added or removed by 05g). The criterion grep of REQ-108 criterion 2 (SELECTOR_GREP of npmrc.test.js as `grep -rnE` over app/test) prints no line (exit 1). No xit, xtest, skip, todo or only in app/test outside the planted strings of the guards; no path of this computer in app/test. Nothing weakened: against the tag 5b the changed files have test( 9, 7, 7, 5 to 6, and `assert.` 118, 152, 46, 53 to 118, 160, 48, 62 for landing, office-view, public-pages, vercel-build (vercel-build one test more), the kit 0 to 1; no line removed but the six readState calls that got the stronger form and the step() signature; `git diff base/M1CODE-20261119-01-5b base/M1CODE-20261119-01-5b2 --stat -- app tools` lists only the five test files.

Stability: the five touched test files three times in a row (20 of 20, 20 of 20, 20 of 20); VB-6, OV-2, OV-3, PP-4 each on its own three times (green); the e2e twice (above). The new waits cannot hang: every wait has a 15 s deadline and is a condition (waitLive, shownKind), and the one mutant that never writes the line (E07) finished in 20 s with a red.

Working tree: the index of the project and the tag are unchanged by this step (every run was in a clone under <scratch>; git status of each of my clones was empty after every batch). BUT the working files of the project changed during my work, not by me: at the end `git status --short` shows app/content/sai-intake.json, app/public/css/site.css, app/public/js/pages/demo.js, app/server/routes/demo.js, app/test/e2e/landing.test.js, app/test/int/demo.test.js, app/test/unit/intake.test.js modified and handoffs/M1CODE-20261119-01/step-02d-code-fixer.json new: a CODE-FIXER round (02d) running at the same time; at my start `git status --short` was empty and the hash list was ecb71c59ee2db035975c856cdda74dd649b0c05f, at the end 34b716d6f09c57ec86229f251566f1b78d96c710. I did not write any of these files; the verdict is for the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-5b2, not for these edits, which will need their own gate.

findings.what: Mutant E04 (that line removed, so the live region keeps the announcement in the earlier language after a language switch) stays green in the whole landing file (9 of 9, run on all of it). The lint of the shown text has no rule that a text of another language is wrong, and the live line is only asserted after a result or a Back. The code's own comment says the page keeps one language; no criterion of REQ-111 or REQ-112 states it, and #live is not visible, so this is a missing guard on a code choice, not a gap in a criterion.
findings.fix: In LD-8, right after the switch to kk (step 'to kk'), assert that #live is empty (or holds the kk text) with the page's own read.

findings.what: Mutant S05 (the sort in tree() removed) stays green: every name VB-6 makes sorts before the directory 'sub' and the folder reader of node lists top entries first, so the unsorted order equals the sorted one on this file system. On a file system that lists in another order the helper would give a different order for the same folder, and a before and after comparison of one folder would still agree, so the refusal checks are not weakened; only the exact lists of VB-6 would vary.
findings.fix: Add a top-level name that sorts after 'sub/' (for example 'z.txt') to VB-6 so the order is pinned by the oracle, or state that the order is not part of the contract.
